h: The Shabbos Lamp Restores Hidden Light Joy and Blessing

p: which is "the light, that it was good."
And in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 167a):
"'Let there be light, and there was light'
why is it written 'and there was light'?
For 'and it was so' would have sufficed!
this is the first light, etc.;
for from the right the left goes forth, etc."
alluded to in "Let there be light";
רַק הוּא אוֹר תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
rather it is the light of the Oral Torah,
except what it receives from the right.
that there be an Oral Torah
After all, the entire Oral Torah
But it is as we said,
that at first everything was included
in the utterance "Let there be light,"
and there was revelation in it.
and there was revealed only what is drawn out
and this is through the person
through the innovation of the Oral Torah.
And this is "with the good lamp":
which come to repair the first blemish,
as it says (Tanchuma, beginning of Noach):
therefore she shall keep the lighting of the lamp";
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה יִזְכּוּ לָאוֹר הָרִאשׁוֹן
and through this they will merit the first light,
as it was before the sin.
And this is "that shines upon heads,"
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמַר (נִדָּה ל, ב)
from one end of the world to the other,
'When His lamp shone over my head'";
and this is like the first light,
from one end of the world to the other,
And this is why we say,
וְהוּא עַל פִּי שֶׁאָמַר בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (שָׁם קסו, ב)
And this follows what the holy Zohar says (Zohar II 166b):
וְהוּא ב׳ חֲלָקִים מִשּׁ״י עוֹלָמוֹת מִימִינָא
And that is two parts of the 310 worlds on the right
and a third on the left,
And this is "and doubled over one,
that the light of two parts will come,
upon the part that is a third,
which is the 103 on the left,
except what it receives from the sun,
like the moon, which has nothing of its own;
and as Rabbi Chaim Vital writes,
that it equals "minchah l'Esav" in gematria
meaning that the root of the blessings
which do not depend on merit
וְאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג עט, ב)
and it is brought in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 79b)
that this is the middah of Atika,
That is, the middah of Atika,
which is the crown of the yud,
which is above the letters of Havayah,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג סה, ב)
as the holy Zohar says (Zohar III 65b):
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב סד, ב)
as the holy Zohar says (Zohar II 64b).
And when one merits the first light,
which is from the dew of Atika,
then one merits these three things,
which are the blessings in general,
as we find in the Torah
the blessing of the fish and of man,
and of life it is written (Shemos 23:25),
"and He will bless your bread and your water,
and I will remove illness from your midst."
"life, etc., I have set before you,
for blessing in general is life.
And this is "and blessings in abundance,"
which is the abundance of blessings
דְּשַׁבָּת כּוֹלֵל כָּל ג׳ בְּרָכוֹת אֵלּוּ
of Shabbos, which includes all three of these blessings:
וְכֵן בְּנֵי זוֹכִין גַּם כֵּן בְּשַׁבָּת
and likewise children are also merited on Shabbos
